list.query: select distinct benchmark from run where kind='BENCHMARK' order by 1
list.definition: select distinct benchmark from run where kind='BENCHMARK' order by 1

list.definition: select distinct branch from run where kind='BENCHMARK' order by 1

list.definition: select distinct db from run where kind='BENCHMARK' order by 1

list.definition: select distinct segment from run where kind='BENCHMARK' order by 1

target.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, g.kpi || coalesce(' ' || (g.dims->>'operation'),'') || ' ' || r.branch || ' / ' || coalesce(r.db,'') || ': ' || round(g.value::numeric,2) || ' vs ' || round(g.baseline_median::numeric,2) || ' | ' || coalesce(g.compare_url,'') as text, 'regression' as tags
from regression g join run r on r.id=g.run_id
where r.kind='BENCHMARK' and r.source='branch' and r.benchmark=${benchmark:sqlstring} and $__timeFilter(r.started_at) and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.db in (${db:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring})

select started_at as time, 'segment ' || prev || ' -> ' || segment as text, 'segment' as tags
from (select started_at, branch, segment, lag(segment) over (partition by branch order by started_at) as prev
      from run where kind='BENCHMARK' and source='branch') s
where prev is not null and prev <> segment and $__timeFilter(started_at) and branch in (${branch:sqlstring})

targets.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, r.branch || ' / ' || r.db || ' (' || r.segment || ')' as metric,
  percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m.value) as value
from measurement m join run r on r.id=m.run_id
where m.kpi='benchmark.median.duration' and r.kind='BENCHMARK' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.benchmark=${benchmark:sqlstring} and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.db in (${db:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
group by r.id, r.started_at, r.branch, r.db, r.segment
order by 1

panels.title: Operation medians per database and branch ($benchmark)

targets.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, r.branch || ' / ' || r.db || ' ' || (m.dims->>'operation') || ' (' || r.segment || ')' as metric,
  percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m.value) as value
from measurement m join run r on r.id=m.run_id
where m.kpi='benchmark.operation.median.duration' and r.kind='BENCHMARK' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.benchmark=${benchmark:sqlstring} and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.db in (${db:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
group by r.id, r.started_at, r.branch, r.db, r.segment, m.dims->>'operation'
order by 1

panels.title: Iteration spread: min / p50 / p95 / max

targets.rawSql:
select r.started_at as time, r.branch || ' / ' || r.db || ' (' || r.segment || ')' || ' ' || s.stat as metric, s.v as value
from run r
join lateral (
  select min(m.value) as mn, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m.value) as p50,
         percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by m.value) as p95, max(m.value) as mx
  from measurement m where m.run_id=r.id and m.kpi='benchmark.iteration.duration') a on true
cross join lateral (values ('min', a.mn), ('p50', a.p50), ('p95', a.p95), ('max', a.mx)) as s(stat, v)
where r.kind='BENCHMARK' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.benchmark=${benchmark:sqlstring} and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.db in (${db:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at) and a.mn is not null
order by 1

select r.started_at + ((m.dims->>'repetition')::int * interval '1 minute') as time, r.branch || ' / ' || r.db || ' (' || r.segment || ')' as metric, m.value
from measurement m join run r on r.id=m.run_id
where m.kpi='benchmark.median.duration' and r.kind='BENCHMARK' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.benchmark=${benchmark:sqlstring} and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.db in (${db:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
order by 1

panels.title: Latest run per branch and database

targets.rawSql:
select distinct on (r.branch, r.db) r.branch, r.db as "database", r.started_at as "run", left(r.commit_sha, 10) as "commit", r.segment,
  (select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by value) from measurement where run_id=r.id and kpi='benchmark.median.duration') as "median ms",
  (select min(value) from measurement where run_id=r.id and kpi='benchmark.iteration.duration') as "min ms",
  (select max(value) from measurement where run_id=r.id and kpi='benchmark.iteration.duration') as "max ms",
  (select count(*) from measurement where run_id=r.id and kpi='benchmark.median.duration') as repetitions
from run r
where r.kind='BENCHMARK' and r.source='branch' and r.status='SUCCESS' and r.benchmark=${benchmark:sqlstring} and r.branch in (${branch:sqlstring}) and r.db in (${db:sqlstring}) and r.segment in (${segment:sqlstring}) and $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
order by r.branch, r.db, r.started_at desc
